reflection: After reading this lesson, is there any support you need to arrange before you begin? Write it down, and write down when you will arrange it.
What would make it easier, or harder, for you to contact your support person if you became overwhelmed?
What are you hoping the retreat itself will accomplish? Mark anything that belongs in the "cannot" section.
What would tell you that your chosen path needs to change before the retreat begins?

checkin.title: Retreat Safety Check
checkin.intro: Before you go further, confirm each of these. This is not a test; it is the agreement you are making with yourself. Completing it does not contact anyone on your behalf.
statements: I understand that this retreat is not a substitute for medical, psychological, addiction, trauma, or crisis care.
I know whether I am proceeding independently, proceeding with support, using an adapted format, or postponing.
I have identified someone I can contact if a session becomes overwhelming.
I know how to access professional, crisis, or emergency support where I live.
I understand that I may pause or stop any exercise.
I will not make an irreversible decision during the retreat unless immediate safety requires action.
I will not stop medication or abruptly stop a substance because of something I experience during the retreat.

options.text: Postpone for now and seek help first

checkin.confirm: I have read and understood the safety guidance and chosen the path appropriate for me.
